domain_truths.name: S/O/D scales and the critical band are stated
domain_truths.oracle: the S/O/D scales (1-10) are stated and the threshold that makes an RPN critical is named - an RPN of 120 means nothing without its bands

domain_truths.name: beta is interpreted on the surface
domain_truths.oracle: beta is interpreted on the surface - <1 infant mortality, ~1 random, >1 wear-out; a bare beta is a number nobody can act on

domain_truths.name: eta carries its unit
domain_truths.oracle: eta carries its unit (hours vs cycles vs starts)

domain_truths.name: P-F states its unit and implied inspection frequency
domain_truths.oracle: the P-F interval states its unit and the inspection frequency it implies (frequency <= P-F/2)

domain_truths.name: criticality names its model
domain_truths.oracle: criticality drives strategy selection and the surface names which criticality model

domain_truths.name: sensor readings state their age
domain_truths.oracle: sensor readings state their age, and v_sensor_recent vs v_sensor_truth are visibly different questions

domain_truths.name: asset MTBF uses only its own failures, windowed
domain_truths.oracle: an asset's MTBF uses only that asset's failures and states its window

domain_truths.name: failure modes follow ISO 14224 where claimed
domain_truths.oracle: the failure-mode taxonomy follows ISO 14224 categories wherever the surface claims it does
